purpose: Teach: フライパン/ティーン/ステッカー/サボっ/つぼみ/吠え/きゅう/じわじわ

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、フライパンで、絶対、お料理、絶対、頑張ってるよね、本気で、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Mom, you're really, truly working so hard with that pan — I'm so grateful.
lines.style: Soft, genuine admiration. Open vowels. Small pause before each major word, like he's thinking it through carefully. Warm and unguarded.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。お兄ちゃん、本気で、絶対、ティーンになって、絶対、ちょっと、絶対、生意気よね、翔くん
lines.en: Mm. Your big brother got a little cheeky when he turned into a teenager, didn't he, Sho.
lines.style: Wry, fond observation. Slight lilt of amusement on 「生意気」. Not criticizing — noticing. Relaxed, the tone of a parent thinking out loud with her child nearby.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃんからもらった、本気で、絶対、ステッカー、絶対、ぼく、絶対、ノートに、貼ったよ、ママ
lines.en: Grandpa gave me a sticker and I stuck it on my notebook, Mom.
lines.style: Quiet pride. Measured pace — he's sharing something he considers important. No rush. Slight lift at the end, checking that she's listening.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 宿題、本気で、絶対、サボったら、絶対、ダメよ、翔くん、本気で、絶対、約束
lines.en: Don't skip your homework, Sho. I mean it — that's the deal.
lines.style: Gentle but firm. The tone shifts slightly here — still warm, but with a parent's quiet insistence. Not stern. Just clear.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 庭の花、本気で、絶対、つぼみが、絶対、たくさん、絶対、咲きそうだよ、ママ、本気で、絶対、楽しみ
lines.en: The flowers in the garden have lots of buds coming up, Mom — I'm really excited to see them bloom.
lines.style: Bright, animated whisper. Energy in the vowels but kept soft, like he's sharing a discovery. Slight breathiness. Pace picking up toward the bloom.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うちの犬、本気で、絶対、お客様が来ると、絶対、よく、絶対、吠えるわよね、翔くん
lines.en: Our dog barks quite a bit whenever guests come over, doesn't he, Sho.
lines.style: Observant, gentle reflection. Slight smile in the voice. Not complaining — noticing a small habit of the house. Calm, almost meditative.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、きゅうに、絶対、お休みが、絶対、決まったって、ママ、本気で、絶対、嬉しい
lines.en: Dad just got an unexpected day off — I'm really happy about that.
lines.style: Genuine, unguarded delight. Quick pace, like the news just came in. Soft brightness — not performed, just naturally pleased. Open-vowel warmth.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 外、本気で、絶対、寒くなってきて、絶対、じわじわと、絶対、冬の気配ね、翔くん
lines.en: It's getting cold outside, Sho — that quiet feeling of winter creeping in.
lines.style: Tender, close whisper. Slow pace. Slight inhale before speaking, like she's feeling the season. Drifts gently at the end — reflective, intimate.
